subject: Next steps: MAP & dataset exchange — access terms and test-case scope
messages:
From: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa@novumai.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Novum AI Legal <contracts@novumai.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP / eval artifacts — next steps

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the low-latency answers looked promising. As we discussed, our evaluation team needs a mutual action plan (MAP) and the artifact set (prompt pack + test cases + a small sample dataset) so they can validate freshness and hallucination behavior across our top-20 intents.

A few asks from our side:
- A concise MAP with milestones and responsible owners so our PMs can slot this into the Q3 plan.
- A short usage covenant for the artifacts (we can't redistribute raw prompts or share with 3rd parties).
- A sample of test cases in CSV form we can run locally against our harness.

Target timeline: start eval by 9/8 and complete internal sign-off by 9/18. Is that feasible?

Also looped in Legal for any standard mutual evaluation agreement (we prefer a simple MPA vs a full SOW).

Best,
Alyssa Cheng
Head of Product, Novum AI
alyssa@novumai.com
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa@novumai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Novum AI Legal <contracts@novumai.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / eval artifacts — next steps

Alyssa — thanks for the clear asks and the timeline. We can meet your schedule. Attached is a first-pass MAP and the artifact bundle we typically share for controlled evaluations. Highlights below and next steps: 

Attachments (attached to this email):
- MAP_v1.docx (milestones, owners, success criteria)
- eval-test-cases.csv (30 representative test rows; columns: id,intent,context,expected_label,notes)
- prompt-pack-v1.zip (readme + 12 example prompts; see caution in the readme)

Key usage constraints (summary):
- Artifacts provided for evaluation only; no production inference or resale.
- Recipients limited to Novum employees listed on the MPA.
- No public dissemination or embedding in customer-facing products.
- Retention: destroy local copies 90 days after completion unless extended by written agreement.

Legal: we prefer a short MPA (mutual evaluation agreement). I created a DocuSign powerform for the MPA to keep this moving: https://na.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef-123456

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
1) 9/3 — share MAP + artifacts (this email)
2) 9/4–9/7 — Novum runs smoke tests on the CSV & prompts
3) 9/8 — kick off structured evaluation (3 weeks)
4) 9/29 — joint quality review, gap list, and next steps

If you want, we can tighten the ramp to finish sign-off by 9/18; that will need a focused 2-week eval window and a short joint review session the week of 9/14.

Next step: please have your legal sign the MPA and reply with the list of Novum teammates who need artifact access so we can add them to the access control list.

Thanks — looking forward to moving fast.

— Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa@novumai.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Novum AI Legal <contracts@novumai.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 08:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / eval artifacts — next steps

Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of clarifying questions from our engineering and legal leads: 

Engineering:
- Are the test-case IDs stable across prompt-pack versions (we'd like deterministic mapping so results are comparable)?
- Can we get a short README that prescribes the exact scoring rubric you used for the sample expected_label column?

Legal:
- Is the 90-day destroy a soft guideline or a contractual requirement in the MPA? Our procurement prefers a clause that allows one 90-day extension by mutual written consent.

If we can get answers to the two engineering bullets and a draft MPA clause for the retention/extension by EOD Monday (9/7), we can aim to sign that day and start the eval on 9/8.

I'll also send the names of the four engineers who need access after Legal confirms.

Best,
Alyssa
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa@novumai.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / eval artifacts — next steps

Hi Alyssa — Laura here (solutions engineering). Quick answers and a couple of helpers attached.

Engineering answers: 
- Test-case IDs in eval-test-cases.csv are stable for the v1 pack; we use UUIDs and a version field so you can map results across prompt-pack.bz2 releases. When we push a new prompt-pack, the CSV will include a prompt_pack_version column.
- Scoring rubric: attached redwood-eval-sample-scenarios.pdf has the rubric we used to produce the expected_label column (precision/recall thresholds, human review fallback rules). Also attached prompt-pack-readme.md inside the zip and replicated here with the minimal guidance we recommend for fair comparisons.

Legal / retention: 
- The 90-day destroy is intended to be a contractual MPA clause. We're happy to add an explicit one-time 90-day extension option by mutual written consent. The proposed MPA language (section 3.b) has that exact wording.

Operational note: once the MPA is signed, we will:
1) provision a time-limited S3 bucket with object-level access logs (read-only) for Novum engineers;
2) enable an IP allowlist and pre-signed URLs that expire after 14 days for initial downloads;
3) add a small sample dataset (anonymized 5k rows) rather than full production exports.

Attachment(s): redwood-eval-sample-scenarios.pdf, prompt-pack-readme.md

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the rubric and mapping.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Novum AI Legal <contracts@novumai.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / eval artifacts — next steps

Alyssa — quick update to lock things in: 

1) MPA signed: I can confirm Novum's MPA was completed via DocuSign this morning (receipt attached via the powerform link). That triggers artifact provisioning.
2) Access list: once you send the four engineers' emails, we'll add them to the S3 ACL and issue short-lived download links.
3) Timeline: we will provision the eval bundle and the anonymized 5k sample dataset by 9/8 morning PST. We can support the faster 2-week eval window you mentioned; to meet sign-off by 9/18 we'll schedule a 60-minute joint quality review 9/15 at 10am PT — does that work for your team?
4) Usage constraints (contractual summary): evaluation-only; recipients limited to named Novum employees; destroy copies 90 days after completion with one 90-day mutually agreed extension; no public sharing; logs/audit trail retained by Redwood for 180 days for compliance.

Next steps for Novum:
- Legal: confirm extension workflow (we've added language to Section 3.b).
- Product: share the 4 engineer emails.
- Ops: confirm the 9/15 review slot if you want to accelerate sign-off.

I'll also add the HubSpot record for tracking and link the evaluation artifacts to the deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/NUV-78

Thanks — excited to get this underway.

— Karthik
